scope_note: Post-snapshot (after 2026-10-25) function ports by the agents, keyed by original binary SHA-256 and entry RVA like the frozen ledger. Tier differential means original-data or instruction-level round-trip proof on top of tests; tier contract means reviewed upstream source plus Rust tests. Inline code regions without entries (recompile walk body, S_timer Reset/Tick, C_chunk::Write), explicit unsupported boundaries, and game-global stores without function entries are not counted as functions. VM script commands are tracked separately below, not as functions.

Region 0x1000-0x1170 fully mapped contiguous, no gaps; Binja-only gap is zero. Oct 26-Nov 3 non-rw_data intake batches (actor factories, VM families, vehicle owners) remain unaudited and count at zero.
